item.title: About
item.description: Welcome to monoflora — a quiet corner of the internet for anyone who finds peace in petals, soil under their nails, and the rhythm of growth. I’m Oliver. A person who believes that tending to plants is one of the most grounding, beautiful things you can do. Monoflora is my space to share the little joys of plant life — from creating natural bouquets to watching a seedling become a garden centerpiece.
